adaptations: Training session 10. The vehicle dyn:evaluate is tier 3: its src/dynamic.xsl slot terminates the transformation with xsl:message terminate=yes (dynamic XPath evaluation is not implementable in pure XSLT 3.0) and is demonstrated in the lesson, never in this golden. The golden pins the session's exercise instead: a pure-XSLT operation dispatcher — a registry map from op-name to function item (anonymous functions plus a named function reference), a map:contains guard against unknown ops (a missing key's empty sequence raises XPTY0004 when called, engine-verified), a fold-left map-accumulator summary, and a filter+for-each rejected list. This is the typed, compiled, safe answer to the use case that motivates dyn:evaluate for KNOWN operations. All function-item/HOF constructs used were empirically verified on Bosak 0.12.3-beta before authoring (see the session README).
